journal_lines: §lPillager§l patrol on the road. Closed the distance before the crossbow was up.
Bolt in the dirt by my forepaw. Closed. Dealt with it.
§cBolt caught my ear. §oHeard the creak and moved, but not enough.§o Finished it anyway.
Picked off the one that wandered from the outpost. Clean.
Two in a clearing. Took the crossbow first. Then the other.
§oSmelled the torch-smoke from a long way off.§o Knew the count before I got close.
Watched the patrol from the ridge. Picked my moment. Came home clean.
Three of them and a banner. Flag's on the ground now.
§lPillager§l at the treeline, watching the road. Came up behind.
§cBolt grazed my shoulder. §oGot clear of the line and came around the flank.§o Felled it.
One wandered off from the group to investigate something. I was that something.
Better armed than most. Took more care. Still cleared it.
